keyVerseDR: "Thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he saw and followed him in the way." (Mk 10:52)

level1.title: Bartimaeus Sees!
level1.story: Blind Bartimaeus sat by the road. He shouted, "Jesus, have mercy on me!" Jesus healed him, and he followed Jesus.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, have mercy on me. Amen.

activity.title: Bartimaeus comes to Jesus
activity.intro: Trace Bartimaeus' path from the roadside to Jesus.

level2.title: Blind Bartimaeus
level2.story: As Jesus was leaving Jericho, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the wayside begging. He heard it was Jesus of Nazareth and began to cry out, "Jesus, son of David, have mercy on me." Many told him to be quiet, but he cried out even more. Jesus called him, and casting off his cloak, he jumped up and came. Jesus asked, "What wilt thou that I should do to thee?" He said, "Rabboni, that I may see," and he received his sight and followed Jesus.
level2.keyLine: Thy faith hath made thee whole.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What would you ask if Jesus said, 'What do you want me to do for you?'
level2.prayer: Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me. Amen.

activity.title: Who am I?
clues: I sat by the road near Jericho, begging.
I cried, "Jesus, son of David, have mercy on me!"
I threw off my cloak and asked to see.

art.mainBrief: Bartimaeus throwing off his cloak, running to Jesus
